name: pipe_file_operations

provenance.source: nx_pipe 0xC1A609C (and pipe2 0xC1A5F88) allocate the 1024-byte FIFO, format the '/var/pipe/%d' name and call register_inode 0xC1AFFD8 with this table as its second argument; register_inode stores that argument into inode+16, sets mode bits in inode+14 and the private FIFO in inode+24. The table's ten words are the pipe implementations 0xC1A6375/0xC1A6249/0xC1A6525/0xC1A6611/0/0xC1A68BD/0xC1A5F79/0/0xC1A6789/0, identical under the XIP alias 0x0CCBE5A4.

notes: Identity compared at inode+16, never called. The cached alias 0x2CCBE5A4 is what the firmware passes to register_inode.
